title: Letters and Promise Anew
author: Silas Pemberton
blurb: Ansel Lockridge, a cellist recovering from one catastrophic final performance, has spent fifteen years rebuilding a life measured in small safe steps. Then a lost letter surfaces, postmarked eleven years ago — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, he must forgive the person in the mirror first before the last ferry of the season departs.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
